decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Aluren to continuously cast creatures for free, allowing the player to generate card advantage and control the board. By combining various creatures with Aluren, the deck can create infinite loops to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The deck includes disruptive elements like Leovold and Endurance to protect the combo and ensure consistency. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to set up a winning combo, utilizing cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana quickly. The deck also includes disruption cards such as Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, as well as personal tutors to help find and assemble the necessary pieces. The inclusion of Thassa's Oracle as a win condition allows the deck to win on the spot once the combo is set up. This deck aims to quickly establish a game-winning board state through a carefully planned sequence of plays.

This deck focuses on quickly generating a massive amount of mana with Gaea's Cradle and Heritage Druid, while utilizing cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to untap creatures for additional mana. The deck then aims to draw through the deck with Glimpse of Nature, finding key combo pieces like Nettle Sentinel and Allosaurus Shepherd. Once a critical mass of creatures is on the battlefield, Natural Order or Green Sun's Zenith can be used to fetch game-ending threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Archon of Valor's Reach for a powerful finish.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board through a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with counterspells like Force of Will. It also utilizes efficient removal such as Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. The deck's win conditions include powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Dack Fayden, as well as disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can close out with a finisher like Hidetsugu Consumes All.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board control through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. With cards like Force of Will, Fatal Push, and Baleful Strix, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from gaining an advantage. Additionally, cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide card advantage and disruption. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Hullbreacher and Hidetsugu Consumes All to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to take advantage of the synergies between its Human creatures, utilizing cards like Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls to cast them quickly and efficiently. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Meddling Mage and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while also providing aggressive threats with creatures like General Kudro of Drannith and Sanctum Prelate. The deck also includes disruptive lands like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to further hinder the opponent's plans. Overall, the deck is focused on applying pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through the strategic use of lands. By utilizing cards like Crop Rotation and Life from the Loam, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Punishing Fire and Sylvan Library provides additional control and card advantage. With multiple land-based win conditions such as Dark Depths and Exploration','','');">Valakut Exploration, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent by managing the battlefield and resource allocation effectively.

This Legacy Aggro - Ninja deck focuses on quickly getting creatures like Changeling Outcast and Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow onto the battlefield to deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Brazen Borrower and Baleful Strix for additional control and removal options. The strategy is to utilize cards like Brainstorm and Force of Will to manipulate the top of the library and counter opponent's spells while maintaining card advantage. The deck includes a mix of creatures, removal spells, and card draw to maintain a strong tempo and pressure the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly and effectively getting powerful creatures onto the battlefield by utilizing cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. By cheating out creatures like Griselbrand, Emrakul, and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, as well as card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and protect its game plan. Additionally, acceleration like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide help to get ahead on mana and execute the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while controlling the game tempo with cheap and efficient spells. By utilizing powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, along with disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Pyroblast, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes card selection and manipulation spells like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistency and find the right answers at the right time.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively tempo the opponent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and removal spells. By utilizing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, backed up by cards like Delver of Secrets and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the game through card advantage and tempo advantage. The inclusion of cards like Daze, Force of Will, and Snuff Out further enhances the disruptive nature of the deck, allowing it to maintain control of the battlefield while applying pressure on the opponent.

The key concept of this UR Tempo deck is to control the tempo of the game by utilizing cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt your opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to pressure them and close out the game quickly. By maintaining a balance between disruption and aggression, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure a victory through fast-paced gameplay and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this deck revolves around playing aggressive tempo-based creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats and stall the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful removal like Lightning Bolt and efficient card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder help the deck maintain its momentum and outpace the opponent. The land base is built to support the deck's mana requirements and disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.
